pre_fit_correction: Python 3.9 streaming SHA compatibility added after a pre-source-loading failure; zero native models had started.

historical_frame.excluded_reason: AP2022 codebook says national estimates only; positive state-weight values do not create state qualification

current_frame.source: CHEP2026 all positive CHEP_WEIGHT records in 50 observed states
current_frame.likely_voter_nonvote: modeled current N, not observed abstention

predictor_contract.historical_prior: QPVVOTE20 routed nonvote or actual recalled QVOTE2020; forced-choice QVOTE2020S forbidden
predictor_contract.age_education_interactions: each prior by each native age/education field

weight_and_vocabulary_protocol.regularization_weight_normalization: positive training weights divided by positive training-row mean only
weight_and_vocabulary_protocol.zero_weights: retained in source inventory, excluded literally from weighted fit/score frame
weight_and_vocabulary_protocol.negative_or_invalid_weights: retained as routing counts and excluded; any occurrence is a source warning

accepted_baseline_differences: Older accepted CHEP/AP holdout code fitted DictVectorizer vocabulary on all records before splitting; this new ablation fits vocabulary on training rows only.
Older accepted CHEP/AP holdout code divided by the all-record weight mean; this new ablation divides by the positive training-row mean only.
Older accepted AP transfer consumed every positive state-weight row; this new common state-qualified frame excludes AP2022 DE/WV from both training and AP2024 scoring.
No older accepted estimator, prediction, synthetic prior, state estimate, default, or public artifact is altered.

calibration.table: overall five-class weighted observed share and weighted mean prediction

promotion_rule.requirement: strict improvement versus prior_only in both log loss and Brier on both AP transfer and CHEP holdout
